for cmd in [["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=name,clocks.sm,clocks.mem,clocks.max.sm,clocks.max.mem","--format=csv"],

    print(cmd, r.returncode, r.stdout[-500:], r.stderr[-300:])

import inspect
print(inspect.signature(b200probe.harness_time), inspect.signature(b200probe.cuda_kernel))
